name: Bottega Pizzeria
hours: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Sunday, 5 to 9 p.m. Thursday to Saturday, 5 to 10 p.m. Closed Monday.
why: Good for groups, private events, a seasonal terrace, and a wine list heavy on organic Italian producers. It has no private room, but it is the best fit here for a large group.

name: Buvette Beaubien
hours: Monday to Thursday, 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. Friday, 11 a.m. to midnight. Saturday, 10 a.m. to midnight. Sunday, 10 a.m. to 11 p.m.
why: It has a private dining room for up to 40 people and takes reservations. The menu is a natural wine list with charcuterie, cheese, and composed dishes such as mushroom polenta. There is also a terrace.

name: Café Guerrero
hours: Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
why: Rotating lunch menu with vegetarian options. Weekday lunch only, so it works only if the group has a free weekday midday.

name: Caffè Italia
hours: Monday to Wednesday, 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. Thursday, 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. Friday, 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. Saturday, 7 a.m. to 11 p.m. Sunday, 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.
why: A Little Italy landmark with 1950s decor, espresso drinks, and paninis. It is listed as good for groups, has a seasonal patio, and stays open late on weekends. Counter service, no online reservations.

name: Dépanneur Le Pick Up
why: Google describes the sandwiches as gourmet and veg-friendly. It seats about 20 inside and 20 outside in summer. Daytime only, so it suits a lunch.

name: Épicerie Pumpui
hours: Daily, noon to 3:30 p.m. and 4:30 to 9 p.m.
why: Classic Thai dishes with a terrace in season. The room is small (about six tables) and waits are common. No online reservations, so call (514) 379-3024.

name: Mon Petit Poulet
hours: Tuesday to Sunday, 5 to 9 p.m. Closed Monday.
why: Casual comfort food with a liquor license (beer and wine). Google offers a “Find a table” link. A 2018 review put seating at about 25, so it is best for a smaller group. Vegetarian options are not listed.

name: Pizza Bouquet
hours: Sunday to Thursday, noon to 9 p.m. Friday and Saturday, noon to 9:30 p.m.
why: Compact, no-frills counter spot selling slices or 16-inch pies. It is quick and cheap, but a poor fit for a seated group dinner.
